title: approval-key
description: The approval key of one feature, written by the runtime where the proposer cannot write. Feature 101 (T002); the field list is the table "Approval key" of specs/101-gate-and-verdict/data-model.md, and the specification stands where the two differ.

keyId.description: The identity of the key: a hash of the key material

feature.description: The feature the key belongs to

key.description: The key material. It is never in an event, a log, an export without signature, or an environment (F100-FR-052)
